question: Find the city with the largest population that uses English.
reference_sql: SELECT T1.Name ,  T1.Population FROM city AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.CountryCode  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language  =  "English" ORDER BY T1.Population DESC LIMIT 1
